Features

Everything in your wardrobe, amplified

👗
Digital Wardrobe

Upload and tag your clothes once. OutfitsGen keeps your entire closet organised and searchable in one place.

🤖
AI Outfit Generation

Our model learns your style, the weather, and your calendar — then suggests complete looks ready to wear.

🌤️
Weather-Aware Styling

Outfits adjust automatically to the day's forecast so you're never underdressed or sweltering.

🛍️
Smart Shopping

Spot gaps in your wardrobe and discover curated recommendations for pieces that complement what you own.

📅
Occasion Planner

Planning a trip or event? Build a packing list and week-view outfit calendar in seconds.

🔗
Share Looks

Export outfit cards to share with friends or post directly to your social channels with one tap.
